target.intended_analysis_population: All randomized participants in the comparison groups

measurement.method: Local radiology assessment of PFS according to RECIST version 1.1; progression or death from any cause, censoring event-free participants at last adequate tumor assessment.

time_point_or_window.description: From randomization until first documented progression or death; November 3, 2017 primary PFS data cutoff (median follow-up 20.4 months).

reported.analysis_population: Full analysis set comprising all randomly assigned patients (484 assigned ribociclib plus fulvestrant and 242 assigned placebo plus fulvestrant); 210 and 151 PFS events, respectively, at data cutoff.

relation_rationale: The article reports the exact investigator/local radiology PFS comparison in all randomized participants at the November 3, 2017 primary PFS data cutoff: ribociclib plus fulvestrant versus placebo plus fulvestrant, HR 0.593 (95% CI 0.480 to 0.732).

applicability.rationale: Patients were individually randomly assigned 2:1 to two parallel treatment groups.

classification: Development-exposed mechanism/scientific-warrant diagnostic, not accuracy/generalization or cleanOctober1 replay
